question: How did later thinkers respond to the inference-based position?
premises: The teacher named Lolaṭa determined a widely accepted position.
Another thinker took up that position.
That thinker conceded some validity to perceptual awareness.
inference: The inference-based view was influential but prompted partial concession to perception.
plain_english: This position was determined by the teacher named Lolaṭa and accepted by many; another thinker took it up and said, 'True, perceptual awareness also has validity.'
